technology_name: FLEXIBLE AND PRINTABLE ELASTOMERIC MEMORY DEVICE STRUCTURES FROM ELASTOMER FULLERENE DERIVATIVE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Flexible Memory Hardware / Data Storage Fabrication
problem_solved: Conventional data storage architectures are brittle, rigid, and cannot be integrated into flexible or wearable electronics without risking structural fracturing under strain.
description: Fabrication of a flexible, printable, and non-volatile elastomeric memory device structure achieved by grafting fullerenes using fully catalyst-free routes, resulting in a thin charge-trapping active medium capable of nanosecond operation cycles.
applications: Wearable biomedical data loggers, flexible smart cards, fold-out electronic systems, and conformable aerospace electronic skins.
